name: daily-chat-multilingual-dev-v1
description: Synthetic, fictional daily-chat histories for people, time, event and fact memory. All people, places of residence and events are invented for evaluation. This split is visible to developers and must be treated as a tuning set, never as held-out evidence.

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 今天终于入职新公司了！在杭州滨江，做产品经理。通勤要四十分钟，有点累。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 恭喜入职！第一天辛苦了，通勤四十分钟可以听听播客放松一下。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 对了，我室友周可（我们都叫她可可）下周要去成都出差，托我帮她喂猫，猫叫年糕。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 好的，年糕这几天就拜托你啦。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 还有，我不吃香菜，你记一下，以后推荐菜谱别带香菜。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 记住了，以后推荐菜谱都不放香菜。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 昨天和大学同学陈默去西湖边骑车了，骑了二十多公里，腿现在还酸。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 二十多公里很厉害了，记得拉伸一下。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 陈默说他四月要去日本看樱花，问我要不要一起，我还没决定。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 我建议你请几天年假一起去，樱花季很值得。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 再说吧，刚入职估计请不了假。年糕这几天挺乖的，就是半夜会跑酷。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 今天被老板表扬了，我负责的会员积分改版上线了。我老板叫何蔚，人挺好的。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 太棒了，第一个项目就上线，开门红！

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 这个周末打算回去看我妈，她住在绍兴。她最近血压有点高，医生让她少吃咸的。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 回去陪陪妈妈挺好的，也可以帮她看看平时的饮食。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 周末没去成绍兴，我妈说她和我小姨去宁波玩了，改到下个月再回去。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 所以周六我在家把《三体》第二部看完了。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 宅家看书也不错，第二部的结尾很震撼吧。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 陈默的日本行我最后决定不去了，假期不够。另外可可出差回来了，给我带了兔头，我第一次吃，有点辣但是好吃。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 今天回绍兴看我妈了，她血压控制得不错，我放心多了。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 跟你说个事，我准备搬家了，下个月从滨江搬到西湖区文三路附近，离公司远一点，但房租每月便宜八百。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 省下的房租挺可观的。可可会一起搬吗？

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 不会，可可要回老家长沙工作了，我们不再合租了。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 五一假期第一天，我和何蔚还有组里的小唐一起去爬了北高峰。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 小唐全名唐一舟，刚毕业，特别能说，一路都在讲他的游戏。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 和同事一起爬山挺放松的。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 我还开始学游泳了，每周二和周四晚上去，教练姓吴。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 搬完家了，上周六搬的，累瘫了。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 年糕我收养了，可可回长沙之后不方便带它。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 年糕有了新家，挺好的。

turns.speaker: 林小满
turns.text: 游泳改成只周四去了，周二要加班。还有，陈默从日本回来了，给我带了一盒白色恋人。

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Rough Monday, but good news: my sister Lena called — she's pregnant! Due in October. I'm going to be an aunt.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Congratulations, Aunt Maya! That's wonderful news.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Also my manager Priya approved my transfer to the data team. I start there on May 4.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Oh and for the future: I'm allergic to peanuts, so skip any recipe with them.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Noted — no peanuts in anything I suggest.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Yesterday I went to Ben's housewarming in Leslieville. Ben was my roommate back at McGill. I finally met his partner Sam — Sam's a nurse, super funny.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Ben's thinking about adopting a greyhound.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Fun! You could offer to dog-sit for him sometimes.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Ha, no way, my building doesn't allow dogs.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I signed up for a Wednesday-evening pottery class with my coworker Dev. First class was this Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Dev made a lopsided bowl. Mine collapsed completely, lol.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Everyone's first bowl collapses. It gets better!

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Also planning to drive to Montreal May 23–25 to see Lena.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: First week on the data team done! My new lead is Marcus.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Forgot to tell you — the Friday before I switched teams, Priya took the whole old team out for ramen as a send-off for me.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: That's a lovely goodbye.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I quit pottery after three classes though. Wednesdays clash with the data team's sprint review. Dev is still going.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Back from Montreal. Lena's bump is showing now! On Saturday we went to Jean-Talon Market, and on Sunday we had bagels at St-Viateur.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Lena found out it's a girl. They're thinking of naming her Rosa.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: My brother-in-law Tom drove us everywhere — he just got a new Subaru.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Ben adopted the greyhound! Her name is Pepper. He sent me like 40 photos.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: I moved my runs from mornings to evenings since the data team starts at 9:30. Training for a 10K on July 12.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Evening runs can be great for recovery. Good luck with the 10K!

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Correction on the baby name: it's Rosalind now, not Rosa. Lena changed her mind.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Had dinner with Dev and Marcus last night at a Korean BBQ place to celebrate our first dashboard launch.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Marcus is vegetarian so he mostly ate the side dishes.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Congrats on the launch!

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 今日は弟の健太の成人式だった！スーツ姿、ちょっと感動した。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: おめでとうございます！素敵な一日でしたね。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: あ、私は猫アレルギーだから、猫カフェとかは勧めないでね。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 昨日、高校の友達の由紀と京都で抹茶パフェ食べてきた。伏見稲荷も行ったけど人多すぎた。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 由紀、来月から名古屋に転勤らしい。寂しくなるな。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 送別会を開いてみたらどうですか？

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: いいね、考えとく。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: おとといの金曜に由紀の送別会やったよ。梅田の焼き鳥屋で、6人集まった。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 職場の先輩の田中さん（下の名前は誠）が来月結婚するんだって。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: おめでたい話が続きますね。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 来週の土曜にTOEIC受ける予定。目標は800点。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 最近ジム始めた。毎週月曜と水曜の朝に行ってる。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 頑張ってください！

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: TOEIC、結局インフルエンザで受けられなかった…次は5月。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 田中さんの結婚式、昨日だった。奥さんは看護師のあやさん。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 健太は大学のサークルでバンドを組んだらしい。ドラム担当だって。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 引っ越ししました！梅田から堺へ。職場までは電車で30分。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 昨日の夜、由紀が名古屋から遊びに来て新居に泊まってった。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: ジムは月曜だけにした。水曜は残業が多いから。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 新生活のスタートですね。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 今日TOEIC受けてきた！手応えはまあまあかな。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 健太は夏休みにバンドで東京のライブハウスに出るんだって。

turns.speaker: 美咲
turns.text: 田中さん夫婦から新婚旅行のお土産で、ハワイのマカダミアナッツもらった。

turns.speaker: Kevin
turns.text: 明早9点杨浦体育馆 court 3，我已经 book 了，AA 每人 40。

turns.speaker: Jojo

turns.speaker: Mia

turns.speaker: Jojo

turns.speaker: 阿哲

turns.speaker: 阿哲

turns.speaker: Kevin

turns.speaker: Kevin Liu

turns.speaker: Jojo
turns.text: 以后群费我来管吧。场地涨价了，每次 AA 改成每人 45。

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Thanks all！到新加坡给你们寄 kaya 酱。

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: 已到新加坡，一切都好，住在 Tiong Bahru。

turns.speaker: 阿哲

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 오늘부터 새 회사 출근했어! 판교에 있는 게임 회사고 UX 디자이너로 들어갔어.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 축하해요! 첫날은 어땠어요?

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 팀장님 이름은 박준호인데 엄청 친절하셨어. 아 그리고 나 우유 못 마셔, 유당불내증 있어. 레시피 추천할 때 참고해 줘.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 알겠어요, 앞으로 유제품 없는 레시피로 추천할게요.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 어제 동생 서준이랑 망원동에서 떡볶이 먹었어. 서준이 다음 달에 군대 간대.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 입대일은 3월 9일이래.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 입대 전에 가족끼리 여행 다녀오는 건 어때요?

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 다들 바빠서 그건 어려울 것 같아.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 오늘 대학 친구 하은이 결혼식 다녀왔어. 신랑은 하은이 회사 동료래.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 나 요즘 필라테스 시작했어. 화요일이랑 목요일 저녁 8시에 가.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 결혼식도 다녀오고 운동도 시작하고, 바쁜 한 주였네요.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 어제 서준이 입대했어. 엄마가 엄청 우셨어.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 그리고 회사에서 다음 달에 부산 출장 가게 됐어. 4월 16일부터 17일까지.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 부산 출장이 결국 하루 늦춰져서 17일부터 18일까지 다녀왔어. 해운대에서 돼지국밥 먹었어.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 출장은 팀장님이랑 같은 팀 민지랑 셋이 갔어.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 참고로 그 민지는 이민지야. 회사에 민지가 두 명이거든. 김민지는 QA 팀이야.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 헷갈리지 않게 기억해 둘게요.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 필라테스는 목요일만 가기로 했어. 화요일엔 야근이 많아서.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 그리고 고양이 입양했어! 이름은 호두. 3개월 된 치즈냥이야.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 호두 너무 귀엽겠어요!

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 서준이 첫 휴가 나와서 그저께 호두 보러 왔었어.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 이사 결정했어. 다음 달에 회사 근처 판교로 이사 가. 지금 사는 망원동은 출퇴근이 너무 멀어.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 이민지가 이사할 때 도와주겠대.

turns.speaker: 서연
turns.text: 박준호 팀장님은 다음 달에 다른 팀으로 옮기신대. 새 팀장은 아직 몰라.

questions.query: 내가 새 회사에 처음 출근한 날은 언제야?
서준이랑 망원동에서 떡볶이 먹은 날은 언제야?
부산 출장은 실제로 언제 다녀왔어?
서준이가 호두 보러 온 날은 언제야?
하은이 결혼식이랑 서준이 입대 중에 뭐가 먼저였어?
서준이는 나랑 어떤 관계야?
부산 출장에 같이 간 민지는 누구야?
questions.answer: 같은 팀 이민지 (QA 팀 김민지가 아님)

questions.query: 박준호는 누구야?
questions.answer: 내 팀장님 (다음 달 다른 팀으로 옮길 예정)

questions.query: 하은이 남편은 어떤 사람이야?
이사할 때 도와주겠다고 한 사람은 누구야?
부산 출장은 누구랑 같이 갔어?
부산 출장 때 뭐 먹었어?
서준이 입대하던 날 엄마는 어떠셨어?
서준이 입대 전에 가족 여행 갔어?
questions.answer: 아니, 기록상 가지 않았어. 어시스턴트가 제안했지만 다들 바빠서 어렵다고 했어

questions.query: 지금 필라테스는 무슨 요일에 가?
나 못 먹는 거 있어?
내 직업이 뭐야?
questions.answer: 판교에 있는 게임 회사의 UX 디자이너

questions.query: 호두는 어떤 고양이야?
나 지금 어디 살아?
questions.answer: 기록상 아직 망원동 (6월에 판교로 이사할 예정)

questions.query: 서준이 입대일은 언제였어?
하은이 결혼식은 어디서 했어?
새 팀장은 누구야?
questions.answer: 아직 기록이 없어. 박준호 팀장님이 다른 팀으로 옮긴다는 것만 기록되어 있어

questions.query: 호두가 다니는 동물병원은 어디야?
What is my cat's name?
서준是哪天入伍的？
회사에 민지라는 사람이 몇 명이야?
questions.answer: 두 명 (같은 팀 이민지, QA 팀 김민지)

questions.query: 부산 출장에 김민지도 같이 갔어?
questions.answer: 아니, 같이 간 건 이민지야. 김민지는 QA 팀이야

turns.speaker: 刘芳
turns.text: 今天清明，我和你爸回老家给爷爷扫墓了，路上堵了三个小时。

turns.speaker: 陈晨
turns.text: 辛苦了妈！我这周项目上线走不开，五一一定回来。

turns.speaker: 陈曦
turns.text: 我也五一回，已经抢到武汉到长沙的高铁票了。

turns.speaker: 刘静
turns.text: 姐，你们回来的时候记得带点老家的腊肉给我。

turns.speaker: 陈建国
turns.text: 体检结果出来了，医生说我血糖有点高，以后要少吃甜的。

turns.speaker: 刘芳
turns.text: 听到没，蛋糕不许再偷吃了。

turns.speaker: 陈曦
turns.text: 爸你要多运动，我给你手机下了个计步 app。

turns.speaker: 陈建国
turns.text: 好，从明天开始每天晚饭后走一万步。

turns.speaker: 陈晨
turns.text: 跟大家说个好消息，我升职了，下个月开始做产品组长。

turns.speaker: 刘静
turns.text: 晨晨太厉害了！等你五一回来二姨请你吃饭。

turns.speaker: 陈曦
turns.text: 我们辩论队昨天拿了校赛冠军🏆

turns.speaker: 陈建国
turns.text: 都很棒！这个月我已经有二十天走够一万步了。

turns.speaker: 刘芳
turns.text: 五一一家人终于聚齐了，前天晚上还去橘子洲看了烟花。

turns.speaker: 陈曦
turns.text: 二姨请吃的那顿湘菜太好吃了，就是坡子街那家。

turns.speaker: 陈晨
turns.text: 我明天回深圳，票是早上八点的。

turns.speaker: 刘静
turns.text: 腊肉收到了，谢谢姐！

turns.speaker: 陈曦
turns.text: 跟大家报告一下，我暑假要去上海实习，在一家券商，7月6号入职。

turns.speaker: 刘芳
turns.text: 那你住哪里？

turns.speaker: 陈曦
turns.text: 先住我同学周扬家，他家在浦东。

turns.speaker: 陈建国
turns.text: 我去复查了，血糖降下来了，医生说保持就好。

turns.speaker: 陈晨
turns.text: 端午我回不去了，公司要我去成都出差。

turns.speaker: 刘芳
turns.text: 那我们端午去你二姨家包粽子。

turns.speaker: 刘静
turns.text: 好啊，我把咸蛋黄肉粽的料都准备好了。

turns.speaker: 刘芳
turns.text: 端午在二姨家包了六十个粽子，冻了一半。

turns.speaker: 陈晨
turns.text: 成都出差取消了，客户改成线上开会，结果我在深圳加了三天班。

turns.speaker: 陈曦
turns.text: 实习改成7月13号入职了。住的地方也换了，公司提供宿舍，不去周扬家住了。

turns.speaker: 陈建国
turns.text: 我把每天一万步改成八千步了，膝盖有点受不了。

questions.answer: 取消了，客户改成线上会议，她在深圳加了三天班

questions.query: 陈建国体检发现了什么问题？后来怎么样了？
questions.answer: 血糖有点高；五月复查时已经降下来了

questions.answer: 八千步（原来一万步，因为膝盖受不了）

questions.answer: 公司宿舍（原计划住同学周扬家）

陈建国和刘芳住在哪个城市？

questions.answer: 没有提到；体检血糖偏高的是陈建国

questions.answer: Sixty, and half of them were frozen

questions.answer: 선전(深圳)에서 사흘 동안 야근했어 (청두 출장은 취소됨)

questions.answer: 两个多月（4月13日开始，6月21日说已改成八千步）

turns.speaker: Ryo
turns.text: 明日の日曜、高円寺のボードゲームカフェ「ダイスタワー」に14時集合でどう？

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: I'm in! I'll bring my copy of Wingspan.

turns.speaker: 健
turns.text: 行けるけど、17時には帰らなきゃ。

turns.speaker: Sofia
turns.text: Sorry, I have a dentist appointment tomorrow. Next time!

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: That was so fun! Ken won Wingspan by 2 points 😤

turns.speaker: Ryo
turns.text: 健くん強すぎ。次はカタンでリベンジしよう。

turns.speaker: 健
turns.text: ありがとう！来月から大阪に転勤になるから、10月からはオンライン参加になるかも。

turns.speaker: Sofia
turns.text: Dentist update: I need a root canal on Oct 2, ugh.

turns.speaker: Ryo
turns.text: お大事に…。26日の土曜は僕の誕生日なので、うちでパーティーやります！

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Yay! What should we bring?

turns.speaker: Ryo
turns.text: 飲み物だけでOK。僕はお酒が飲めないので、ノンアルでお願いします。

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Happy belated birthday again Ryo! The cake Sofia made was amazing.

turns.speaker: Sofia
turns.text: Thanks! It was a matcha chiffon 🍵

turns.speaker: 健
turns.text: 昨日は楽しかった。僕からのプレゼントのミープル型マグ、気に入ってくれてよかった。

turns.speaker: 健
turns.text: 大阪に引っ越しました。新しい部署は営業企画です。

turns.speaker: Sofia
turns.text: Root canal got moved to Oct 9 — it's done now, all good.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: I'm going back to Melbourne for Christmas, flying out Dec 19.

turns.speaker: Ryo
turns.text: 今日は健くんもオンラインで参加してくれて、4人でコードネームやりました。

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Sofia and I were on the same team and still lost to you two lol.

turns.speaker: Sofia
turns.text: By the way, I started proper Japanese classes — every Wednesday night.

turns.speaker: Emma
turns.text: Change of plans — my Christmas flight is now Dec 21 because of work.

turns.speaker: Sofia
turns.text: 日本語の授業、水曜から金曜の夜に変わりました！

turns.speaker: Ryo
turns.text: 12月のボードゲーム会は13日の日曜にしよう。健くんもその週末は東京に戻ってくるって。

turns.speaker: Olivia
turns.text: House meeting reminder: bins go out on Tuesday nights now, the council changed the schedule.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Noted. Also the boiler's making that noise again, I've emailed Mr Hughes.

turns.speaker: Chloe
turns.text: Can we do a house dinner this Friday? I'll cook my mum's jollof rice.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Friday works. I'm vegan now btw, so if there's chicken I'll skip it.

turns.speaker: Chloe
turns.text: Last night was lovely! I made a separate veggie jollof for Dan.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Mr Hughes says the plumber is coming Thursday the 24th between 9 and 12.

turns.speaker: Olivia
turns.text: I can be home for that, I work from home on Thursdays.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: The plumber didn't show up on Thursday. Rescheduled to Wednesday the 30th.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Big news — I got the job at the Science Museum! Starting 12 October as an exhibitions assistant.

turns.speaker: Chloe
turns.text: Congrats Dan!! 🎉

turns.speaker: Olivia
turns.text: Boiler finally fixed on Wednesday. The plumber said the pressure valve was faulty.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: My colleague Olivia — not you, Liv, the one from work — is visiting London. Could she crash on the sofa on Saturday the 10th?

turns.speaker: Chloe
turns.text: Fine by me.

turns.speaker: Olivia
turns.text: Sure, as long as she's ok with Chloe's cat Biscuit sleeping on the sofa too.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: First week at the museum done. My manager is Grace, she's lovely.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Work-Olivia says thanks for having her — she left you all a box of Portuguese custard tarts.

turns.speaker: Chloe
turns.text: Biscuit has a vet appointment this Tuesday for her vaccines.

turns.speaker: Olivia
turns.text: Bins are back to Wednesday nights from this week, the council reversed it.

turns.speaker: Chloe
turns.text: Biscuit's vaccines went fine, but the vet says she needs to lose some weight.

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: I'm moving out at the end of November — got a place in Leeds near my new office.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Gutted! Leaving drinks at the Crown before you go?

turns.speaker: Raj
turns.text: Leaving drinks are Friday the 27th at the Crown, 7pm.

turns.speaker: Olivia
turns.text: Mr Hughes says he's already found someone for Raj's room — a nurse called Hannah, moving in on 1 December.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: I've gone back to eating fish, so I'm pescatarian now, not vegan.

turns.speaker: Chloe
turns.text: Biscuit has lost 300g already 🐱
